info.title: Live Commerce catalog and inventory admin API
info.description: T04 merchant-only slice, not a complete SaaS/live-provider approval. Runtime requests derive Scope from a merchant session; client tenant headers and Host are not authority. No public reserve route.

get.description: Requires catalog:read. Metadata only (no bytes): items ordered main, detail, sku then position; main position 0 is the cover. Also the effective image axis and the option-value links.

200.description: Images of the product

403.description: Visible store but operation not permitted

404.description: Resource not visible in current scope

post.description: Requires catalog:write. Stores one photo of an ACTIVE product at the next free position of its role (product-media-v2, catalog-inventory-v1.md): role main (<=4, position 0 = cover), detail (<=20, height <= 6x width) or sku (one per value of the image axis; option_value REQUIRED and linked atomically). A full role, an already-linked value or an archived product is 409; an option_value that is not on the image axis is 422. Idempotency-Key replays the first result for the same file bytes; another file under the same key is 409. Body over 2 MiB + framing is 413 invalid_request; a non-multipart body is 415.
